title: Native MACA launch requires two scratch pointer slots not visible in Triton 3.6 TTGIR
observation: Two broker-held sealed NT FP8 baseline attempts exit 139 at mcModuleLaunchKernel. TTGIR has three public pointers, but native ELF MetaX metadata contains five contiguous global_buffer slots; the installed Triton 3.6 launcher appends global_scratch and profile_scratch. A 24-byte extra-buffer control returns runtime status 1. Holding the same native ELF, tensors and launch shape fixed, a separate broker job maca-2bca8cb21b6c that appends two null scratch pointers returns status 0 and matches all 4096 primary outputs exactly with unchanged inputs. External vLLM activity was present; no timing was measured. This is a single-case ABI diagnostic, not all-case qualification. The retained Triton 3.1 native ELF declares only three global_buffer pointers.
proposed_change: Inspect native ELF launcher pointer metadata at compilation/sealing and loader admission, retaining TTGIR as the public tensor ABI check. Refuse missing metadata, scalar/unsupported arguments, name/count disagreements and nonzero or unmodeled scratch requirements. Append only the sealed artifact-derived zero scratch pointers. Preserve old receipts and requalify all 37 Workload cases through the repaired exact Executor.
promotion_disposition: Repair pending. The version-bound diagnostic supports a native ABI fix, not a new instruction, precision contract, performance estimate or fallback.
